candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that assigns totalDistributed to balances[owner] so the owner receives no tokens in NETM().
Replace the assignment balances[owner] = totalDistributed with balances[owner] = totalRemaining, crediting the owner a different amount.
Invert the onlyOwner check so non-owners can invoke NETM(), letting a non-owner caller set balances under a new owner.
Delete the statement that decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender], so the allowance is never reduced by transferFrom.
Replace the allowance decrement with an increment, so transferFrom adds the transferred amount back to the allowance.
Replace the allowance update so it sets allowed[_from][msg.sender] to _amount instead of subtracting it.
Change the payload-size check from >= to > so calls with exactly the minimal data length revert, leaving allowed unchanged where the original would have decremented it.
